name: HNA Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: HNA Technology Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates dry bulk shipping routes in Southeast Asia, Australia, and the Americas. The company operates 10 dry bulk carriers that primarily transports iron ore, coal, steel, nickel ore, and bauxite. It also engages in bulk commodity trading and property management. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Tianhai Investment Co., Ltd and changed its name to HNA Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2018. HNA Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Tianjin, China.
